title: 3.11 Luis's bag is bigger
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
goal: Say whose thing it is with a name + 's (It's Ana's bike. / Luis's bag is bigger than Sofia's bag.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.11 Our and Their: A1 says whose things are with our and their; A1+ 3.11 names the owner. The one new grammar relationship is a name + 's before the thing (Ana's bike, Luis's watch), taught against her (Her headphones are black. / Ana's headphones are black.). After a name that ends in an s sound, 's is spelled Luis's and said as one more syllable (LU-i-siz). The cast's things from A1+ 2.2-2.3 and their floors from A1+ 2.7 come back with 's (Ana's apartment is on the sixth floor.), and a new photo of Luis's big black bag and Sofia's small red bag brings back 2.11's bigger and smaller and 2.5's but.
prerequisite: A1 3.10 his and her; A1 3.11 our and their; A1+ 2.2 bike and car; A1+ 2.3 watch, wallet, camera, headphones; A1+ 2.5 but; A1+ 2.7 floors; A1+ 2.11 bigger and smaller.
speaking_outcome: Link 's to the name (AN-uhz, so-FEE-uhz); say Luis's with one more syllable (LU-i-siz). Do not require native-like speed.
